## Summary

Describe the user problem and the smallest solution implemented.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `pnpm run scan:credentials` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes when runtime behavior is affected.

## Database and security

- [ ] Schema or migration impact is documented, or this change has none.
- [ ] RLS and user-scoped data isolation were reviewed, or this change does not affect them.
- [ ] No environment files, credentials, production identifiers, or deployment artifacts are included.
- [ ] No real appointments, account details, email addresses, logs, or private screenshots are included.

## Notes

List any limitations, manual verification, or follow-up work. Use synthetic data and redact all private information.
